mapper.select: select from knowledge_document where knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and deleted = false order by update_time desc, id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select from knowledge_document where knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and deleted = false order by id
select count(*) from knowledge_document where knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and deleted = false

insert into knowledge_document (knowledge_base_id, source_type, file_id, title, raw_content, index_version) values (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{sourceType}, #{fileId}, #{title}, #{rawContent}, #{indexVersion}) returning id
mapper.update: update knowledge_document set status = 'INDEXING', index_version = #{indexVersion}, error_code = null, error_message = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{documentId} and deleted = false

update knowledge_document set status = 'READY', active_index_version = #{indexVersion}, index_version = #{indexVersion}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_code = null, error_message = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{documentId} and deleted = false
update knowledge_document set content_hash = #{contentHash}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{documentId} and deleted = false
update knowledge_document set status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{documentId} and deleted = false
update knowledge_document set deleted = true, status = 'DELETED', update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and deleted = false
